origin.description: Turn a table of raw moments into cumulants.

arguments.name: mu.raw
arguments.text: Raw moments from order 0 upward, as a vector, matrix, or data frame. In Python the argument is mu_raw.

origin.details: The first stored cumulant is 0. The second is the first central moment, which is 0 for a raw-moment table that came from data. The third is the second central moment. Later orders use the binomial recurrence. A data frame comes back as a data frame with columns X1, X2, and so on.
origin.value: A vector, matrix, or data frame of the same shape as mu.raw.
